title: Build a real coffee workshop page, revise it, and open the repaired preview

provenance.kind: Genuine screen recording of operator actions in real software
provenance.operator: Demo operator using agent-operated UI tools

source.storage: Private recording retained outside the repository

edit.method: Chronological actual source intervals at normal speed, joined with hard cuts. Idle waits, terminal clipboard preparation, preliminary site inspection, and wrong-page navigation attempts are omitted. Full frame; no overlays, redrawn UI, artificial typing, or added cursor.
edit.rangeConvention: Start inclusive, end exclusive; seconds from source start
edit.derivedUtcPrecision: Milliseconds, truncated from the nanosecond capture start
edit.captionForFilm: The agent builds First Pour with real tools. After an incomplete first revision, the operator requests one complete repair and opens the corrected preview.

clips.summary: Paste and send the real site brief; observe live filesystem and preview tools complete.

actions.description: Actual clipboard paste changes the empty composer to the site brief
Completed tool card: create_directory, write_file, start_process
actions.evidence: Visible completed state after an omitted idle interval; exact completion instant is not asserted

clips.summary: Paste and send the first revision; show its tool result, then paste and send the actual repair, inspect the final response, and open the corrected preview.

actions.description: Actual paste replaces an unsent URL request with the revision request
actions.evidence: Visible frame transition; the replaced request was not sent

actions.description: First revision shows three edit_block calls and an answer; this is not the accepted repaired result
Actual paste enters the single-write repair request in the chat
Scroll to the final repair response
Click the final localhost preview link
Scroll the actual corrected site to its signup and footer

recoveryContext.initialBuild: The first build completed create_directory, write_file, and start_process, but did not display a readable final answer or preview URL. The operator opened and inspected the local preview separately.
recoveryContext.firstRevision: The model issued three edit_block calls against one file and claimed the revision was complete. Operator inspection found that the served footer still said 2024 and stray script/HTML text remained. The model claim is preserved as evidence, not accepted as verification.
recoveryContext.navigationRecovery: A first repair paste/send attempt occurred while the website was active and did not submit a chat turn. Those wrong-page actions and return navigation are omitted. The clip includes the later genuine chat paste and send.
recoveryContext.actualRepair: The operator explicitly requested read, one write_file correction, then readback. The final response reports footer 2026, no duplicate trailing markup, preserved linked labels, and preserved local-only signup. The final clicked preview visibly has Name and Email labels and footer 2026.
recoveryContext.acceptance: Operator-reviewed in the real UI. The separate final site-acceptance clip records the final interactive desktop and phone checks; this clip alone does not demonstrate all of them.

allowedVisibleData: Public demo agent and conversation titles
Tool names and displayed token usage totals
omitted: Private credential values and credential setup
Private host paths and shell command arguments
limitations: This is a visual media review, not a forensic guarantee about every compressed pixel. Automated scene changes and one-second sampling supplement full-resolution boundary and key-frame review.
The full-frame sidebar includes other demonstration conversations. No real personal signup data is shown.
The footage preserves an imperfect model revision and an operator-directed repair; it does not claim unassisted first-attempt success.

method.findings: No terminal, password field, credential value, private host path, or real personal signup data observed. Public output matches actual captured UI and local preview.

validation.dimensionsAndRate: Both clips are 1600x1000 at 20 fps, with one H.264 video stream and no audio.
validation.content: Actual brief/revision/repair pastes, sends, live tool results, final response, clicked preview, linked visible labels, and footer2026 are captured.
